task.goal: Profile each candidate independently, test both deployment requirements, and rank feasible candidates.
constraints: Use only the supplied fictional source pack; do not search or add outside facts.
Return one bare JSON value with no Markdown fences.
Return an object with profiles, ranking and reasoning. profiles must map each candidate ID to energy_mj, range_m, feasible (boolean) and weakness (text).
ranking must be an array of feasible candidate IDs in the required order. reasoning must explain exclusions and cite numeric comparisons.

rubric.criterion: Keep all candidate measurements and weaknesses separate.
